sources.sponsor_pct: offer doc p341-342 (Unitholding of Sponsor Group): post-Offer Sponsors + Sponsor Group = 148,254,546 (25%, 3-yr lock) + 226,642,535 (>25%, 1-yr lock) = 374,897,081 units = 63.2% of 593,018,182. notes: Sponsor % = Sponsor + Sponsor Group, post-issue (derived by summing the two lock-in buckets; the RHP prints only a PRE-Offer 85.31% combined figure).
